name: docker-desktop
title: Docker Desktop
description: The Docker Desktop engine (WSL2 backend) that LibreChat runs on. start waits synchronously for the engine; stop and restart interrupt every running container, LibreChat included.

exit.1: engine did not come up within 120 s, or Docker Desktop is not installed

actions.name: stop
actions.confirm: Stops EVERY running container, LibreChat included.

exit.1: stop failed, or Docker Desktop is not installed

exit.0: engine restarted and up (WSL2 backend ready)
exit.1: engine did not come back within 180 s, or Docker Desktop is not installed
